mapper.select: SELECT m.*, t.tag FROM movie m LEFT JOIN tag_movie t ON m.id = t.movieId WHERE m.release_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM showtimes s WHERE s.movie_id = m.id AND s.showdate >= CURDATE()) ORDER BY (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM showtimes s WHERE s.movie_id = m.id AND s.showdate >= CURDATE()) DESC, box_office DESC LIMIT #{size}
select m.* ,t.tag from movie m left join tag_movie t on m.id=t.movieId where m.release_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP order by m.want_number desc limit #{size}

select m.* from movie m ,movietype mt,movie_type_mapping mtm
and mt.id=mtm.type_id and m.id=mtm.movie_id
and mt.id= #{typeId}
and m.region like concat('%',#{region},'%')
and m.release_time like concat('%',#{year},'%')
order by m.box_office
order by m.release_time
order by m.score

select m.banner,m.id from (select DISTINCT s.movie_id from cinema c ,showtimes s WHERE c.id=1 and s.cinema_id=#{queryId} and s.showdate > CURRENT_DATE ) new_movie, movie m where m.id=new_movie.movie_id ;
SELECT mt.typename,mt.id from movie m,movietype mt , movie_type_mapping mtm where m.id=#{movieId} and mtm.movie_id=m.id AND mtm.type_id=mt.id and mt.typename!="全部"
SELECT DISTINCT movie.* FROM movie JOIN movie_cinema_mapping on movie.id=movie_cinema_mapping.movie_id JOIN cinema ON cinema.account = movie_cinema_mapping.cinema_id ${ew.customSqlSegment}
